verdict: The drawing identity largely survives, and the head lowering and turn broadly follow the source, but the source crouch and occlusion are not yet convincing.

same_drawing_identity.evidence: Angular unfilled outline, polygon head, tiny diamond eyes, sparse mouth and ear remain recognizably the supplied doodle. The absent tail is acceptable in this source view because it is hidden.

source_crop_pose.evidence: The 4:3 view, reeds, water foreground and head-down progression match broadly. In keys 05–08 the drawn torso stretches into a long horizontal oval while the source retains a shorter, bulky hunch.

crouch_occlusion.evidence: The source animal has a compact high rump with belly and feet lost in the water and vegetation. The cartoon exposes a long clean underside and short straight leg marks, making it read as a standing doodle placed above the water.

motion.assessment: sampled progression is plausible; playback unverified
motion.evidence: Decoded comparison samples show head lowering, turn toward left profile and subsequent hold in the source order. This does not establish normal-speed motion quality.

most_important_gap: The compact, partly submerged source crouch becomes an elongated standing silhouette, most clearly in keys 05–08.
smallest_repair: Make one source-matched silhouette pass on the late body keys: shorten the torso around the existing rump position into the observed hunch, and clip the lower belly and leg marks at the source water/vegetation boundary. Keep the existing head path and timing.
must_not_be_lost: The original doodle’s angular black outline, simple polygon head, tiny eyes and sparse facial marks.
The head-down turn and source-relative framing already established.
The source-hidden tail and feet should remain hidden; do not add anatomical detail or a new style.
review_method: Inspected the supplied original design, source contact sheet, all eight source/key pairs, and a 6 fps decoded contact sheet from comparison.mp4. ffprobe inspected cartoon.mp4 (480×360, 24 fps, 67 frames, 2.791667 s). No actual normal-speed playback occurred.
scope: Blind packet review only; no builder notes, tests, earlier critiques, revisions or conversation read.
